head: 4b9259eddb42822c0e64c02a71a6fc85f0a70eec
classification_reasons: The change's plan still projects a wide blast radius once build actually starts: plugin/gate/checks.py, plugin/gate/diff.py, plugin/state/unpark.py, plugin/pr/description.py plus prose in docs/OPERATING_MODEL.md, affecting every project that runs the plugin, not just this repository (intent.md 'Affected users and systems'; plan.md 'Files that change').

A new deterministic gate check at three phases (c, d, e), for every change type, is new behavior with no existing test coverage yet; the plan itself still lists ~20 unit tests to be written once the build session starts.
This specific commit is pre-implementation bookkeeping with zero lines of plugin/template code, but the classification judges the plan behind the change, not just this evidence-sync commit.
attempted: Intent: this diff is not feature work. HEAD (4b9259e) is the fix round's own evidence commit, responding to a CI preflight park recorded before any phase (c) build session started (evidence/gate-c.json: check 'claude_md', reason 'CLAUDE.md does not name the lint command of sdlc.yaml'). It re-syncs fix-requests.json/hook-log.jsonl, writes evidence/fix-response.md's round-2 section, and advances status.yaml. No code for the 'ratchets' feature exists yet; that is consistent with the task framing and with plan.md's own 'Order of work', none of whose files (diff.py, checks.py, unpark.py, description.py, the skills/agent/template prose, the tests) appear in this diff.

Verified the root cause independently rather than trusting the claim: sdlc.yaml:19 sets lint to `python -m ruff check . && python -m ruff format --check .`; CLAUDE.md:55 reads only `python -m ruff check .`; plugin/gate/preflight.py:check_claude_md does a plain substring search of the configured command text anywhere in CLAUDE.md, so the proposed new line 55 (adding the `&&` clause) is the minimal, correct, and sufficient fix -- build and test command strings already match verbatim, confirmed by direct read of both files.

Policies: confirmed the diff touches no guardrail file (.claude/**, CLAUDE.md, REVIEW.md, sdlc.yaml) -- the proposed CLAUDE.md line lives only in evidence/fix-response.md's table, matching plugin/commands/sdlc-fix.md:148-149's explicit rule for a fix round ('answered with the proposed content in evidence/fix-response.md; the owner applies it'), which is the applicable, more specific convention for a /sdlc-fix round (CLAUDE.md's own generic 'docs/PROGRESS.md' bullet is for maintainer session notes, not per-change fix rounds; plan.md step 8's docs/PROGRESS.md row is for the unrelated template/REVIEW.md prose edit the eventual build session will make).

Blast radius: every changed path is inside the change's own evidence/ folder or its status.yaml; nothing under plugin/, template/, docs/, .claude/** or any sdlc.yaml risk_list item is touched by this commit.

Verified status.yaml's counters against plugin/state/status.py's own logic rather than taking the commit's word: record_owner_label(RESET_ITERATIONS_LABEL) zeroes both iterations and panel_calls and stamps iterations_reset_by/at (status.py:236-240); the owner's label commit (09921cb) is a separate, prior commit from this one, and this fix round's own start-run/bump-iteration (sdlc-fix.md step 2) then raises iterations from 0 to 1 -- so the final iterations=1, panel_calls=0 in status.yaml is the expected composition of both steps, not an inconsistency, despite 'iterations: 1' appearing unchanged across the full accumulated diff's before/after context lines.
Checked the actor recorded for the un-park label: iterations_reset_by: luissiviero (a human, not the automation identity), matching decision 11/24's rule that a run cannot un-park itself.

Proof: no test.log/build.log/lint.log/verifier.md is added or claimed, because the phase (c) build session that would produce them never started (the preflight park precedes it); fix-response.md says so plainly ('No build work happened this round ... Not run this round'). Nothing in the diff overstates what was done.
Tests: no test file is added, removed or weakened -- there is no code diff at all in plugin/template for this commit, so this angle has nothing to find.

Noted but deliberately not used as a reason (per instructions): evidence/panel/c-items.json's dry-run park ('evidence/ lacks verifier.md') is the gate's own deterministic finding, left for the gate to act on, not cited here.

Confirmed the previous evidence/adversarial-review-c.json committed in this same diff carries a stale head (09921cb, before the fix round's own commit) and is the file this verdict overwrites, as the task directs.
